historical_notes.birth_year_accounts: Britannica/EBSCO give 1714 or circa 1714; Gale gives 1715; ages remain approximate.
historical_notes.early_accounts: EBSCO’s 1733 narrative and Gale’s 1737 narrative remain separately attributed as uncertain accounts; conflicting details are not blended.
historical_notes.reconstruction: Collection tasks, village repairs, meetings, NPC dialogue, settlement population/layout, creek, bridge, well, stall, seats, animals and encounters are explicitly labeled in Burmese as gameplay reconstruction, not verified biography or census.
historical_notes.mission_progression: Eight sequential missions cover the approximate age-18-to-25 span, with EBSCO and Gale episodes kept separate.

validation.measurement_caveat: Godot headless and Chromium/SwiftShader cloud touch emulation only. Render-follow telemetry is not proof of smoothness or FPS on a physical phone.

changes: Owner reference-sized inset joystick: 144 CSS px touch target, 132.48 CSS px visible ring in short landscape.
Separate 56 CSS px right action circles in short landscape, compact Burmese labels.
No full-width opaque top bar; compact objective and title chip.
Camera uses one interpolated player sample with its own physics interpolation OFF; no positional lag bob.
Collision recovery eased without forcing camera through close walls.
Coalesced drag capped even during a stalled render frame.
